process_decisions.correction_strategy: Append a dated superseding or contesting event; never silently erase the earlier claim.
process_decisions.distinction: Git commit attribution, co-author trailer and AI tool identity describe artifact creation and must not be inferred to prove the origin of the underlying idea.
process_decisions.independent_rediscovery: Record what the author actually worked out, the earlier literature with precise citations once verified, and when the overlap was recognized; never claim global priority or plagiarism based on independent convergence alone.
process_decisions.synergy: Most later research is iterative human–AI co-development, including mathematical modelling, not only a human concept handed to an AI derivation service. Reconstruct intervention–response–correction chains from primary dialogue whenever possible. Do not assign exclusive authorship based on who wrote the final proof.

evidence_policy: Historical published antecedents are comparators, not proof of copying or a source for retroactively dating UBT contributions. Preserve authors' original dated work, independent development and later recognition of overlap as separate statements.
